about: Where each file of an AB package goes. Buckets: vault (enters an API request; publish-ready copy under vault/), code (read by our code at build, run or test time; copied or ported into the project folders), left (stays in AB's folder only). Globs are relative to the package folder. First match wins; anything unmatched is 'left' and must be added here.

destinations.vault-chat: vault/chat/  ->  D:/Git_Virevo/skills-live  ->  S3 via Utility/Virevo.Utility.SkillsPublisher.Cli (when KT says)
destinations.vault-tools: vault/tools/  ->  D:/Git_Virevo/skills-live/tools/  ->  S3 as tool_files in the manifest (the publisher carries the whole folder, README.md excepted, since 1 Oct 2026); read by the live tool engine through the vault in both modes
destinations.generator: VirevoService_Dev/Chat/Virevo.Chat.Canvas (ported C# since 30 Sep 2026; assets/, blocks/registry.json embedded beside it)
destinations.ui-fonts: VirevoUI_Dev/src/assets/fonts/ (still to copy; the API embeds the fonts from Chat/Virevo.Chat.Canvas/assets/fonts until Tools:FontsHref is set)
destinations.chat-tests: VirevoService_Dev/Tests/Virevo.Chat.Canvas.Tests/fixtures/ab-v5 (the replay oracle); the twelve example specs also in Chat/Virevo.Chat.Business/Tools/script/discharge (the scripted engine)
destinations.vault-chat-ondemand: vault/chat/_rules-NN-name.md with kind rules-ondemand: published with the chat skills, in a prefix only where the code asks for it by id
